sources.scope: 2020–2022 Escape, 2021–2022 Bronco Sport, 2022 Maverick, build through 2022-03-23, North American bulletin

sources.title: Ford response to NHTSA PE23-021 Request 2: Pretensioner B007E/B007F
sources.document_type: Ford submitted investigative response, not a WSM pinpoint test
sources.scope: Ford reports in seatbelt-retractor-pretensioner inquiry; no exhaustive VIN or model applicability per individual DTC
sources.evidence: B007E and B007F code occurrence with airbag warning and high-resistance/open pretensioner circuit condition

limitations: Bulletins confirm code occurrence and conditional fitment, not universal English definitions
SRS Ford response does not establish B007E/B007F exact module or model and has no approved code-to-side mapping
NHTSA-hosted Ford bulletins are Ford OEM service publications; NHTSA is the host, not a generic code definition source
